gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuk: Thick, tracing-one-thread lettering up top. College draws bold, authoritative display forms, while Noto Sans Bhaiksuki keeps its tight, rope-like lowercase and open apertures for the text underneath.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: College draws every curve as heavy as its straight stems, a flat, unswelling line that never thins out. Noto Sans Brahmi stays light beside it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Steel-cable outlines, no thick-thin shift at all. Noto Sans Buginese follows with open-mouthed letters and short ascenders, a lighter touch that lets College's heavy line stand out.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Heavy diagonals, as hefty as the stems around them. Noto Sans Buhid then lets in space between curve ends and stems, with a high-set x-height guiding the eye along.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-carian: College looks like it was traced with a single marker, every stroke the same bold weight and the counters big. Noto Sans Carian has terminals that stay apart, which lightens everything.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Tails and terminals as thick as the main stems give College its blunt, confident shape. Noto Sans Chakma works the other way, packing its lowercase up toward the caps with open, uncrowded s and c shapes.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham brings open, rounded lowercase forms. College sits above it with round letters whose walls are as heavy as its straight ones, a sturdy, dynamic partner.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee gives a tall band of letters with short stalks. Over many lines, its e with a wide gap at the terminal reads openly, a quiet foil to College's bent steel rod.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-chorasmi: College looks cut from heavy rod, its s spine as thick as its terminals. And Noto Sans Chorasmian, with its large x-height and curves that stop short, would feel lost if the heading shrank.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Diagonals heavy as stems, big counters, real swagger. Noto Sans Coptic hands back a middle-zone-heavy texture with open s and c mouths, so College's weight has something lighter to push against.
